title: Exit Annual kWh and the Length of Billing History - C&I
content:
**Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts - contract exits: exit annual kWh by billing history.**

The exit annual kWh depend on how many billed cycles were posted in the twelve months before the handling date: one to eleven such cycles give the window's kWh divided by the billing days of the counted cycles, multiplied by 365 days per year; no cycle in the window gives the kWh of the most recently posted cycle multiplied by 12 months per year; twelve or more give the window's kWh.

## Terms used

- **Window:** A line falls in the twelve months before the handling date when it was posted on or before the handling date and fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed from its posted date to the handling date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the posted date.
- **Cycles counted:** each cycle once, by its energy charge line; on a block and index contract by its block energy charge line, the index energy charge lines then not being counted; otherwise by its index energy charge line.
- **Billing days of the counted cycles:** the billing days shown on the lines that count the cycles, added together.
- **The window's kWh:** the kWh on the contract's supply lines posted in the window.
- **The most recently posted cycle:** the cycle of the supply line with the latest posted date, whenever posted; its kWh are the kWh on all supply lines of that cycle.
- Nothing is rounded here; the figure carries its decimals into the exit kWh.

| Cycles in the window | Exit annual kWh |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | the window's kWh |
| 1 to 11 | the window's kWh divided by the billing days of the counted cycles, multiplied by 365 |
| none | the kWh of the most recently posted cycle multiplied by 12 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- 12 cycles with 2310000 kWh: 2310000.
- 8 cycles with 1420000 kWh over 243 billing days: 1420000 divided by 243, multiplied by 365, that is 2132921.81.
- No cycle in the window, the most recently posted cycle carrying 151200 kWh: 151200 multiplied by 12, that is 1814400.
